summary: Iteration 22 (Profile, MobileTabBar, Guest Invite, Stripe Billing + AI Credits) — full backend + frontend E2E PASSED. 15/15 pytest backend tests pass; all critical Playwright UI flows pass (Profile save, mobile tab bar hide/show + /call hide, credits-widget, Billing 3-plan view, owner-only gating, invite-guest dialog → credentials card).
critical_code_review_comments: Profile change-email endpoint accepts any new email immediately without verification (no confirmation email round-trip). Acceptable for MVP but consider an email-verification flow before billing-critical features land.
Stripe checkout endpoint stores Stripe API key in env; ensure /api/billing/checkout is only reachable behind auth (it is — uses require_user + role check). Good.
services/billing.py FREE_GRACE_CREDITS=50 is hardcoded; consider moving to plan config so future plans can have different grace thresholds.

InviteGuestToChat creates a fresh user with a one-time password but does NOT force a password reset on first login. The guest could keep using the auto-generated password forever; consider a first-login password change prompt.

routes/billing.py: webhook handler at /api/webhook/stripe — verify Stripe sends signature over the public ingress; if not, webhook plan updates will silently no-op (status-poll fallback at /billing/checkout/status/{session_id} still works).
